title: Freelance Invoice Cashflow Processing Lag Trend
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=freelance:invoice
| where paid_lag_days=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(paid_lag_days) as avg_lag_days max(paid_lag_days) as worst_lag_days by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how long freelance invoice cashflow items are taking to close, get paid, or get resolved.
value: Lag trend is a practical health metric because it shows whether the financial workflow is getting smoother or more clogged.
implementation: Write a numeric lag field during ingest or derive it from created and resolved timestamps.
visualization: Line chart of monthly average and worst lag days.
grandmaExplanation: It spots whether freelance invoice cashflow is getting handled quickly or dragging on too long.
